name: ikid
description: Ikid — local-first personal finance dashboard. Your money never leaves your machine.

scripts.dev: npm run db:setup && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.start: npm run db:setup && npm run start --workspace server
